content: I will use the Protocol agent to create a detailed experimental procedure. This procedure will serve as the foundation for generating the Python code needed for decoding. The experiment_name parameter is set to "DNA Data Decoding" to specify the purpose of the procedure. The file_ids parameter is populated with the ID of the file containing the information gathered from the Literature agent, ensuring that the procedure is based on the correct decoding logic. Finally, the pure_software parameter is set to True, as this task only involves software and does not require any hardware interaction.
